datasets.name: eGram Swaraj (eGS)
datasets.description: A comprehensive administrative and governance dataset combining financial planning, budgeting, expenditure, and project approvals with extensive unstructured media and documentation across Gram Panchayats in India. It pairs deeply nested transactional records with rich empirical evidence, including geotagged asset photography, administrative sanction orders, engineering technical approvals, and Gram Sabha meeting deliberations.
datasets.administrativeSource: Ministry of Panchayati Raj (MoPR), Government of India.
datasets.purpose: Primary financial management and planning backbone enabling transparent fund transfers, accounting audits, and public accountability under the 15th Finance Commission and state grants.
datasets.unitOfObservation: Granular financial transactions, project vouchers, and individual planned activities.
datasets.geographicCoverage: Pan-India coverage with deep localized data for Odisha Panchayats (Statewide Scraped).
datasets.architecture: Hierarchical multi-level JSON arrays paired with flat CSV voucher exports and mActionSoft geospatial image repositories.

datasets.name: Panchayat Nirnay
datasets.description: The official digital governance repository of multimodal Gram Sabha proceedings, capturing photographic evidence, meeting notes, attendance records, official resolutions, and video recordings. Audited across the 20 pilot Gram Panchayats (1,319 media files). This dataset provides the empirical verification layer ensuring that local developmental works originate from legitimate, quorate citizen assemblies.
datasets.administrativeSource: Ministry of Panchayati Raj (MoPR) in collaboration with NIC, supporting nationwide Gram Sabha documentation.
datasets.purpose: Provides definitive audit evidence for democratic participation and legal compliance. Enables computer vision and multimodal LLM analysis to verify quorum attendance, transcribe handwritten Odia/Hindi meeting notes, extract citizen demands, and cross-reference resolutions with planned expenditures in eGram Swaraj.
datasets.unitOfObservation: Individual Gram Sabha meeting session, with granular multimodal attachments classified by content type: Attendance Sheets, Meeting Decisions & Notes, Meeting Agendas, Session Photographs, and Video Recordings.
datasets.geographicCoverage: 20 Pilot Gram Panchayats across Odisha districts (Bargarh, Sambalpur, Koraput, Rayagada, Malkangiri, etc.).
datasets.temporalCoverage: Meetings registered and conducted between 2024 and 2026.
datasets.architecture: Hierarchical directory structure: District > Block > Gram Panchayat > Meeting Session Folder, with standardized semantic prefixes: [ATTENDANCE]_*.jpg, [DECISION]_*.jpg, [AGENDA]_*.jpg, [PHOTO]_*.png, and [VIDEO]_*.mp4.
